entries.game_version_and_source: v1.0 build 1026.0_64 (main window title, logged as [win-name] hwnd=0x2007a text="Rise of the Tomb Raider v1.0 build 1026.0_64"). The user's own installed Steam binary; nothing redistributed. 27,584,064 bytes, ImageBase 0x140000000, sha256 d56353d9... before any patch.
entries.patch_applied: tools/rotrr-heap-patch.py lowered the compile-time 3072 MB CDC reservation to 768 MB (immediate at RVA 0x3C3717 / file 0x3C2D17). Applied to the PC copy only; the device runs a separate copy. The reservation then succeeded on device, which the patch had never been tested for.
entries.drm_assessment: Steam DRM present (steam_api64.dll, steamclient64.dll, GameOverlayRenderer64.dll). Not analysed, not bypassed, no component worked around. The game runs to its main menu, so the DRM is not the blocker here.
entries.device_limits: RAM 7672 MB, jetsam limit ~3376 MB, free Apple Developer account: no increased-memory-limit, no extended-virtual-addressing. CPU 6 cores reported to the guest as MADEIRA_CPU_COUNT=2.
entries.winephone_commit: f8c3f8d (the build that produced the evidence below; includes [map-rate] ml1216 and [alloc-fail-ex] ml1217)
entries.profile_and_backend_versions: Madeira v0.1.3 (4); wine 9129e968 (branch madeira-lgpl, LGPL-2.1); FEX f59cab95 (FEXCore Source/Interface/Core); dxmt 128b297c; JIT enabled via StikDebug (CS_DEBUGGED set), no debugger attached; unsigned IPA, sideloaded and re-signed
entries.resolution: 1280x720, Aspect Fit, FPS limit 60, Start Directly, NVIDIA GPU reported
entries.reached: Main menu, then a level load. The first level load aborts.
entries.fps_or_frame_time_method: [gpu-perf] ml1254, a 64-frame window sampled inside DXMT: 48.7 fps in one phase and 29.0-29.9 fps in another (64 frames in 2139-2206 ms, GPU busy 1.0-0.8 ms/frame). This is a DXMT-side window, not a whole-game frame-time measurement, and is reported as such.
entries.logs_or_crash_signature: [guest-log] tid 0038: [ASSERT] Fatal error: ERROR: Default Heap Allocator: Out of memory, "UNKNOWN" requested 870240 bytes (849.8 kB 0.8 MB) (999488844 total free (976063.3 kB 953.2 MB)), followed by the game's own int3. Reproduced across three runs with different swap/VRAM settings; the requested size 870240 is identical every time.
entries.verdict: The 3072 MB reservation is fixed and no longer blocks anything. The level-load abort is inside the game's own allocator (docs/ROTTR_HEAP_OOM.md): the host refuses nothing, the address space is stable, and the game's own free counter disagrees with its own decision.
